about.full: Suveoo (from Estonian suveöö, 'summer night') is a trusted execution layer for banking agents: the LLM may only propose operations, which are compiled into a typed BankAction IR and must pass the five verifiers of the Suveoo Verification Runtime (policy tiering, consent binding, provenance taint tracking, financial invariants, replay idempotency) before execution. Banks may swap the underlying model; authorization, compliance and audit rules do not change with it.
about.intro: Suveoo is an Agentic Banking Control Plane: it strictly separates probabilistic AI intelligence from deterministic financial authority. AI can only propose; proposals must pass five deterministic verifiers before touching funds.

ph.willSendTo: The code will be sent to
ph.switchNote: You can change the default code channel in Security Center

sec.otpChannelNote: High-risk actions, 2FA, recovery and unlock codes default to this channel (switchable per action).
sec.unbindWhy: For security, unbinding requires an email code. The number will be released and can bind to another account; codes revert to email.

dl.winNote: The installer is unsigned: if SmartScreen appears on first run, choose "More info → Run anyway".
dl.wstep1: Tap "Download for Windows" to save the installer
dl.wstep2: Run it; if SmartScreen appears on first run, choose "More info → Run anyway"
dl.wstep3: Follow the wizard, then open Suveoo and sign in
dl.macRequireVal: macOS 11 or later (Intel & Apple Silicon, universal)
dl.macNote: The package is not notarized: on first launch, if macOS says it cannot verify the developer, right-click Suveoo and choose Open, or allow it in System Settings → Privacy & Security.
dl.mstep1: Tap "Download for macOS" to save the DMG
dl.mstep2: Open the DMG and drag Suveoo into Applications (overwrite to upgrade)
dl.mstep3: On the first-launch security prompt, right-click Suveoo → Open (once only)
